en.headline: Linn pledges public account on Queen Mary Hospital lift defects
en.dek: Development chief Bernadette Linn said a report for the Chief Executive would detail how problems with 24 of 28 lifts in the new clinical block arose and when they were identified.
body: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said on Saturday that her bureau would submit a full report to the Chief Executive on defective lifts at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block and that the findings would later be made public.

Nearly two weeks after Chief Executive John Lee directed the Development Bureau to investigate and report within a month, Linn told a television programme that the report would examine why the issues occurred, when they were identified and why they had not been detected earlier.

Only four of the 28 lifts in the 34-storey Clinical Block 1 are currently fit for normal service. The Architectural Services Department has said the remaining lifts suffered frequent operational instability and that rectification work is targeted for completion in the fourth quarter of 2026.

Linn stopped short of confirming whether the Heads of Departments Accountability System would be invoked, saying the first phase of the follow-up investigation had already begun. Contractors are required to bear the full cost of remedial works.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪承諾就瑪麗醫院升降機問題向公眾交代
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪表示，將向行政長官提交報告，交代新臨床大樓28部升降機中24部出現問題的原因及發現時間，報告其後會向公眾披露。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪周六表示，局方會就瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機缺陷向行政長官提交完整報告，報告其後會向公眾披露。
行政長官李家超早前指示發展局在一個月內提交報告。甯漢豪在電視節目中指，報告會詳細交代問題為何出現、何時被發現，以及為何未及早察覺。
新臨床大樓共有28部升降機，目前只有四部可正常運作。建築署指其餘升降機經常出現運作不穩，目標於2026年第四季完成修復。
甯漢豪未有確認會否啟動部門首長問責制度，只表示跟進調查第一階段已經展開。承建商須承擔全部修復費用。
